parameters.name: AlarmDetail
parameters.description: The alert content details included in the policy.

parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The cluster ID.

><notice>This parameter is deprecated. Use the Scopes parameter to specify the scope of clusters to which the policy applies.></notice>.

parameters.name: ClusterName
parameters.description:
The cluster name.
><notice>This parameter is deprecated.></notice>.

parameters.name: ImageName
parameters.description: The list of image names included in the policy.

parameters.name: Label
parameters.description: The list of image tags included in the policy.

parameters.name: MaliciousImage
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the policy supports Internet malicious images. Valid values:

- **true**: Supported.
- **false**: Not supported.

parameters.name: RuleAction
parameters.description:
The action to take when the policy is hit. Valid values:

- **1**: Alert.
- **2**: Block.
- **3**: Allow.

sub_parameters.name: AckPolicyInstanceId
sub_parameters.description:
The policy instance ID in the cluster.
> Call the [GetOpaStrategyDetailNew](~~GetOpaStrategyDetailNew~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

sub_parameters.name: AllNamespace
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether all namespaces are included. Valid values:

- **0**: No.
- **1**: Yes.

sub_parameters.name: ClusterId
sub_parameters.description:
The ID of the container cluster.
> Call the [DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

sub_parameters.name: NamespaceList
sub_parameters.description:
The list of namespaces.

><notice>This parameter takes effect only when AllNamespace is set to 0.></notice>.

parameters.name: StrategyId
parameters.description:
The policy ID.
>Call the [ListOpaClusterStrategyNew](~~2623574~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: StrategyTemplateId
parameters.description:
The policy template ID.
>Call the [GetOpaStrategyTemplateSummary](~~2539952~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: UnScanedImage
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the policy supports unscanned images. Valid values:

- **true**: Supported.
- **false**: Not supported.
